packet.title: Type registry and built-in types (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements the type registry and built-in types of types.h, including subtype relationships such as a map type being a subtype of a function type.

body.p: After . Owns src/types.c, src/types_builtin.c, src/types_internal.h, tests/types_test.c. All of types.h (, ). Done when map(xs:string, xs:integer+) is a subtype of function(xs:string) as item()* (map-put-002-hof). Spec: XPath 4.0 "Subtype Relationships"; XDM 4.0 §4. Done 2026-10-16 ().
